description: This file defines the WebKit class, a subclass of BrowserType, responsible for managing WebKit browser instances in the Playwright automation framework. It includes methods for connection handling, environment setup, startup log rewriting, graceful closing, and argument preparation specific to WebKit.

classes.name: WebKit
classes.description: A class representing the WebKit browser type with methods to connect, configure environment, handle logs, close, and prepare launch arguments for WebKit browsers.
